description: Bought a moonberry bush for the cottage garden, $35
body: Bought a moonberry bush at Puddingshire market for $35 and planted it by the gate. It should fruit next summer.

description: Current potions: moonberry tonic 4 drops nightly, thistle draught 1 spoon mornings
body:
As of 1 August 2026:

- Moonberry tonic: 4 drops nightly (2026-07-10, Dr. Jekyll raised it from 2)
- Thistle draught: 1 spoon each morning (2026-06-05, Dr. Jekyll started it)

description: Paid the gnome association's $40 dues for July to September
body: Paid Mr. Pumpernickel, as treasurer, the $40 quarterly dues for July to September.

description: Gizmo's Garage replaced the hovercart's humming anti-gravity coil, $1,240 at 43,900 leagues
body:
The coil had started humming in B-flat. Gizmo's Garage replaced it.

- Odometer: 43,900 leagues
- Cost: $1,240, parts and labour
- Warranty: 2 years on the new coil

description: Gizmo's Garage invoice: anti-gravity coil replaced, $1,240 at 43,900 leagues
body:
